Hero_Desc_Fricle:
The second-in-command of Witch Kingdom, assisting the Witch Queen.
She is always busy planning something and is proud of this aspect of herself.
She pays little heed to what others think when it comes to pursuing her vicious ideals.
Album_Like_Fricle: Multigrain Drink Mix. A high rank or position.
Album_Hate_Fricle: Lower beings than her. Challenges against her.
Album_Wish_Fricle: Becoming a witch who surpasses Belita, to make her feel proud of her.
Album_Fricle1: Queen Belita's second-in command, Fricle, follows and assists her. Fricle's loyalty to the queen is considered peculiar, even among the witches. It seems she might have something up her sleeve...?
Album_Fricle2: Fricle is often seen deep in thought, more than any creature encountered in the forest, which feels a little alien. Whatever she is thinking, only she knows.
Album_Fricle3: There's also a good chance that her deep introspection may not be so shrouded. Every time Fricle goes to bed, she begins craving sweets, naming various types in her sleep. It seems she usually hides in her house, eating snacks.
Album_Fricle4: The only time Fricle and Belita, who she follows, differ in opinion is when it comes to choosing their favorite sweets. When asked. the two always start arguing over why the sweet they chose is the best. This causes them to start fighting, casting spells against each other over something so inane.
Album_Fricle5: Fricle seems to believe she will one day become the next Witch Queen. She diligently studies, and conducts research on, magic, paying close attention to all the witches under her. I discovered a stalking journal, where Fricle had recorded every move of all the witches.
Album_Fricle6: When confronted about said journal, Fricle was at a loss, but still dignified. She claimed to properly control the witches, such measures were required. Having spent time with other witches... As uncomfortable as it may be, I feel as if Fricle might be right.
Album_Fricle7: Fricle sees Elias as one giant problem to be solved. She even said that she doesn't just want to control witches. She wants to control the entire world. That kind of thinking seems... dangerous.
LoveHero_Fricle:
I'm pretty busy,
but if you're asking to come along,
there must be something.
LoveHeroCancel_Fricle:
You won't find
another perfect deputy like me!
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Hate1: Fricle got annoyed, saying this dish reminded her of the days when she was an apprentice witch.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Hate2: She tossed the food away, saying it was too sweet, didn't fit the bill, and had no nutritional value.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like1: With trembling hands, Fricle said, "I'll try to eat it like her," and tried to add a spoonful of sugar. But in the end, she gave up and just enjoyed her drink with a peaceful expression.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like2: When I served this dish to Fricle, she complimented me on making a surprisingly decent meal, despite being someone from the surface.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like3: Fricle slightly dislikes the sweet aftertaste but doesn't seem to hate it.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like4: After tasting a few, she instantly identified such plant ingredients as mugwort. She said that apart from it being slightly sweet, this was an excellent food to eat.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like5: Fricle murmured that witches often need supplements and insisted she should definitely keep it on hand.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like6: Fricle was a bit surprised to learn it was food shaped like a tree. She liked it because it was tasty.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like7: Fricle was very pleased with the unsweetened warm dish. She then asked for carrots to be added as a garnish.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like8: Fricle packed a few while saying it was Queen Belita's favorite. She tried one out of curiously and seemed to find the bitter taste surprisingly good.
Food_ChefNote_Fricle_Like9: Fricle was amazed by the perfect blend of sweetness and the flavor of staple crops. Wait... Fricle praising a candy? That's unexpected!
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Fricle: I'm telling you, there are only idiots.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Fricle:
The harbinger of destruction-
It is me, Fricle!
Fricle_Spawn: Harbinger of destruction~ Lady Fricle has arrived!
Fricle_Spawn1: The harbinger of doom! Here comes Fricle!
Fricle_Spawn2: I guess I have no choice but to step in.
Fricle_Victory2: This should be enough to earn recognition.
Fricle_Defeat1: Where did it all go wrong?!
Fricle_Defeat2: Is this really all I'm capable of?
Fricle_Affinity1_1: I'm not your typical witch. I actually know how to think!
Fricle_Affinity1_2: I can't wait... to be Queen...
Fricle_Affinity2: My brilliant plan has no room for failure, haha!
Fricle_Affinity1_3: You say my plan is a bit strange? Have you finished talking?!
Fricle_Affinity3: I will become a worthy ruler, following in the footsteps of Lady Belita!
Fricle_Affinity4: If no one else will step forward, I will!
Fricle_Affinity5: Sometimes I just want to live easily... just let things happen.
Fricle_Affinity6: Why does no one recognize me? I'm doing all this for Yggdrasil!
Fricle_Affinity7: Do you understand me? Not sure? Hmph!
Fricle_Die1: Ah, no, wait, this isn't right...
Fricle_HeroUpgrade: The authority to subdue all witches!
Fricle_Board: I'm not doing this just because you told me to!
Fricle_Stage: Behold, the power of the Thorn Witch!
Fricle_Touch1_1: You know I'll remember all this, right?
Fricle_Touch2_1: H-huh...? You think I'm happy?! That's ridiculous!
Fricle_Touch1_2: Looks like threats don't work on this one.
Fricle_Touch2_2: Sigh... there's no helping you, is there?
Fricle_DutchRubEnd2: What did you just do to me?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Fricle_Skin1: Fricle was kicked out of the tense witch court on Belita's orders and is now enjoying a day off. The outfit she's wearing was picked out with fashion advice from her former disciple.
Fricle_Growth1_Skin1: You think I am cute? You will pay for that.
Fricle_Growth2_Skin1: This is not bad at all.
Fricle_LevelUp_Skin1: Ugh, a ribbon? It's so cute it feels awkward.
Fricle_Equipment_Skin1: A new outfit? I also like this one.
Fricle_HeroSkill_Skin1: Practice smiling? I'm pretty good at mocking people though.
Fricle_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Adding frills too? Are you looking for trouble?
Fricle_Board_Skin1: Shall we take a light little walk?
Fricle_Touch1_1_Skin1: What the heck is this supposed to be?
Fricle_Touch1_2_Skin1: Eek! I told you not to do that!
Fricle_Touch2_Skin1: What are you expecting from this?
Fricle_Touch2_2_Skin1: I wouldn't mind a bit more.
Fricle_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: I just brushed my hair and you messed it up!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Fricle_Skin2: Fricle became Monatium Broadcasting's weather presenter for a day. Her forecasts are reportedly based far too much on her mood, but viewers seem surprisingly pleased.
Fricle_Growth1_Skin2: This outfit is not bad, right? A witch who used to be my apprentice gave it to me.
Fricle_Growth2_Skin2: You think the ribbon suits me? You are making fun of me, are you not?
Fricle_Equipment_Skin2: A weathercaster needs good equipment too!
Fricle_HeroSkill_Skin2: Today's forecast is thunder and lightning! That is how strong I have become!
Fricle_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Tomorrow's forecast is a storm! I am going to overturn everything!
Fricle_Board_Skin2: Shall we go deliver the weather forecast?
Fricle_Touch1_Skin2: Ngh! Do you want to see me under low pressure?
Fricle_Touch1_1_Skin2: Keep that up and I will not give you the weather forecast.
Fricle_Touch1_2_Skin2: Ngh! This will not change the weather!
Fricle_Touch2_Skin2: Do you think this will earn you any scraps?
Fricle_Touch2_1_Skin2: Today's weather is~ fair enough, perhaps?
Fricle_Touch2_2_Skin2: Be careful when petting the ribbon~
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Fricle_Skin3: Fricle working as a combat maid for the Order. Though she complains constantly as if the role were never her choice, her work remains flawless.
Fricle_Growth1_Skin3: Stay still, Master. I will take care of the work.
Fricle_Growth2_Skin3: Honestly, you are such a high-maintenance Master.
Fricle_LevelUp_Skin3: Hmph, work this simple is no trouble.
Fricle_Equipment_Skin3: Yes, I need equipment of this caliber if I am to care for my Master.
Fricle_HeroSkill_Skin3: Good grief, am I actually getting better at this after doing it so often?
Fricle_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: Well, leave the cleanup to me, Master.
Fricle_Board_Skin3: I was going even without an order from my Master.
Fricle_Touch1_1_Skin3: You know who manages this house, yet you still do this?
Fricle_Touch1_2_Skin3: Hah... Fine. Enjoy yourself while you still can.
Fricle_Touch2_Skin3: D-do you think this will make me show you respect?
Fricle_Touch2_2_Skin3: Well... If you keep treating me only like this, perhaps I will become a little more polite.
Fricle_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Hey!! You think being my Master lets you do anything?!
Aside_Get_Fricle1: You did it, Picora... you finally did it! I don't care if it's an illusion... Picora, my dearest...
Aside_Upgrade_Fricle1: That's wonderful, Picora...! Well done, well done! I was strict with you, but it was all for your own good.
Fricle_AsideGet: At last, you did it, Picora. Even an illusion is enough. Picora, the one I worry about most.
Fricle_AsideUpgrade: How splendid, Picora. Well done, well done. I was strict with you only for your own sake.
Fricle_SkillCast: You will feel your strength draining away.
Fricle_SPSkill1: You can feel your strength draining away!
Fricle_SPSkill1-01: You can feel your strength draining away!
Fricle_Birthday: What? A birthday? What do you expect from me? Stop staring!
Fricle_Gacha2: Harbinger of destruction~ Lady Fricle has arrived!
Fricle_Gacha3: I'm telling you, there are only idiots.
Fricle_Line1: Her Majesty seems to be eating sweets far too often lately.
Fricle_Line2: Honestly, lower-ranking witches need to be kept underfoot.
Fricle_Line3: It is chaotic. Everyone is far too restless.
LoveLetter_Fricle: I can already picture you handling a mountain of paperwork with that stupid look on your face again.You do realize how crucial sorting is before diving into working on those documents, right? Start by grouping similar items together, then prioritize by importance to get through it more quickly. I'm not saying this because I'm worried about you being overwhelmed. I'm sure you've already thought of this, Master.Anyway, keep up the good work today.
LoveCall_Fricle:
Ahem. It is me, Fricle.
You must be wondering why I would call at this hour.
As I finished organizing some documents, I suddenly remembered the Order business you told me about a few days ago.
That matter is proceeding without any trouble, correct?
As long as you handle it exactly as I told you, there should be no problem.
Surely you were not entertaining some naive thought like, 'This should be good enough.' If you were, I will not let you off easily.
Ha, is this not absurd? I am personally monitoring the progress of your work. You should be ashamed.
...H-Hmph, no need to thank me! Do you think I called merely to hear something like that?!
Well, it is not as though I dislike hearing it.
Ahem. I will see you next time.
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_001: Ugh. This unique sweet scent. No matter how much I smell it, I can't get used to the scents of the surface
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_002: It seems like it's because of the sprites.
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_003: Well... Outside the Sprite Kingdom, you can breath in clean air. The scent of pollution lingers somewhat though.
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_004: How about trying some sweet food? It might help you out.
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_005: Hmm... Well. I've tried a few times, but... it gives me goosebumps...
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_006: You seem too sensitive. Can't even handle this much?
Affinity_Fricle_EP01_007: Of course I can! Let me just complain a bit!
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_001: Just because I became a worshipper of the Order, don't assume I'll be praising your every word.
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_002: I didn't make you into a worshipper because of that.
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_003: Hmph, the repertoire of lies that those trying to dominate others always use.
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_004: You don't need to worry about me, but best to be cautious around the High Priestess.
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_005: The High Priestess of the Order? That seemingly insignificant fellow?Is she hiding her strength?
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_006: If you won't follow, then you're not needed.
Affinity_Fricle_EP02_007: What, what's this all of a sudden! Turns out you're a tough one despite appearances? Maybe there IS some worth in following after all...
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_001: How do you even tolerate the other folks?I feel like my stomach's going to explode whenever they cause a ruckus over nothing
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_002: Just keep going, and you'll become accustomed to it.
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_003: Is time the only answer? That's not the solution I was hoping for.
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_004: Most of the time just ignore them, but once in a while just give them a noogie.
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_005: Huh? I can hit them? Wish I'd known earlier, I'd have smacked them hard!
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_006: Gotta break the ice first. Try to understand them.
Affinity_Fricle_EP03_007: So if I try hard enough... can I really understand why they'd set a house ablaze just because the cake doesn't have jam filling?
Affinity_Fricle_EP04_001: Not particularly charismatic, and looks pretty ordinary... How is that possible??
Affinity_Fricle_EP04_003: Why? Feeling guilty? You're quite cute.
Affinity_Fricle_EP04_004: You're talking about the Sprite Queen?
Affinity_Fricle_EP04_005: It could be, or it could not be. Still fits the description I mentioned.
Affinity_Fricle_EP04_006: A person's appearance does not define who they are.
Affinity_Fricle_EP04_007: Are you trying to say that the heart is what matters? Boring words, like this, are tiresome.
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_001: Sometimes I envy the Dragons, with their neatly organized hierarchy. Witches should be like that too.
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_002: You like being challenged on a daily basis?
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_003: Seems better. A direct challenge is better than plotting behind someone's back.
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_004: Now that you mention it, do you get along well with the Dragons?
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_005: They're just... somewhat dull neighbors underground. No need to bother them.
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_006: Do you wish there was a powerful Witch Queen like Daya?
Affinity_Fricle_EP05_007: Wha-what?! Are you mocking Bellita right now? Unacceptable!
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_001: Elementals are quite peculiar, aren't they? What's even their raison d'être?
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_002: What are you saying? Are you making anti-elemental remarks right now?
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_003: Don't try to dodge difficult subjects with false logic.
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_004: The process and outcome of evolution are always mysterious.
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_005: Is it the will of the Yggdrasil? It's full of incomprehensible phenomena.
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_006: They're supposed to protect the nature of Elias.
Affinity_Fricle_EP06_007: You've really become dull. Then can you explain what phantoms and dragons, the relatives of elementals, are supposed to do?
Affinity_Fricle_EP07_001: If Elias can be unified under the name of the Order, it might be a heading in a decent direction...
Affinity_Fricle_EP07_003: Would that be possible? It's about acknowledging the Order, it doesn't matter who becomes the Master.
Affinity_Fricle_EP07_005: Depends on what conflict. Small ones can be stepping stones for good experiences,but the larger, the harder it is to handle the consequences.
Affinity_Fricle_EP07_006: So, then hurry up and pay the Order Membership fee.
Affinity_Fricle_EP07_007: Order Membership fee? Don't just make things up! ...Wait, are you serious?
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_001: Uh, isn't there somewhere quieter? Sometimes I just want to enjoy my food in peace.
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_002: If you really want, I could send you to that solitary confinement over there.
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_003: There's really such an area? Huh? This is just a cleaning tool cabinet!
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_004: It's nice to get along with other folks.
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_005: That's my business to handle! Do you suggest I make friends with just anyone passing by?
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_006: If you stick an olive in your ear, it could work as an earplug...
Affinity_Fricle_EP08_007: Oh? It's quiet and nice.It's great that the one always standing in front of me and lecturing is now pouting and not making any noise.
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_001: Wouldn't it be right for the stronger and more capable ones to rise to higher positions?
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_002: So, that's why I'm in the position of the Master, Hehe.
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_003: ... Right you- I was talking about you, but you completely misunderstood. Or, maybe you're just mentally strong.
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_004: Some pyramid schemes base members’ ranks on how much they spend.
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_005: Hmm, I see. Depending on the perspective, money can also be considered power. That's an interesting system.
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_006: The value of an existence isn't solely determined by abilities.
Affinity_Fricle_EP09_007: Ah, is that all you can say? How disappointing, like reading a textbook.
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_001: Don't you think the folks from the surface are too reckless to worship Yggdrasil?
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_002: What can you do? They were born that way.
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_003: No, perhaps it's about empowering the strong to govern the irresponsible.
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_004: Elves certainly have moments where they, well, go too far.
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_005: Yeah, beings from other worlds lack respect for Yggdrasil! You're on thin ice too, Master.
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_006: Aren't the werebeast coexisting peacefully with the forest?
Affinity_Fricle_EP10_007: Merely existing as they are isn't enough.The werebeasts don't really have what you'd call culture, do they?
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_001: I had an apprentice, you see, but someone took them from me. Quite underhanded, don't you think?
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_002: You had an apprentice who was that ungrateful?
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_003: I don't blame my apprentice... I blame the one who took her from me. I hate them so much.
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_004: I'm sure your apprentice would have stayed with you if you had treated her better.
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_005: I'm pretty sure I treated them fine. Even the lashings came from a place of care.
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_006: Do you have something you'd like to say to whoever took her from you?
Affinity_Fricle_EP11_007: To the one who took her from me? I'd tell them to do a better job keeping the Banquet Hall clean.
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_001: I'll never understand why witches start insurgencies they clearly can't win.
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_002: If they could win, it wouldn't be called an insurgency.
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_003: Either way, they'll never get anywhere... not with me standing in the way.
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_004: Insurgencies are about persistence. You keep at it until one works.
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_005: There hasn't been a single successful one since Queen Belita came to power. Sometimes, you just have to know when to quit...
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_006: They were all well-behaved at the Banquet Hall, though.
Affinity_Fricle_EP12_007: Controlling them with food feels a bit... primitive. But hey, looks like it works.
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_001: The fried carrots taste a little gritty. How are you cooking them?
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_002: But we fry them in fresh oil daily.
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_003: Maybe it's just me? I have been pretty stressed lately.
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_004: Did someone forget to wash the carrots today...?
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_005: Do a better job managing your ingredients! It's the basics of food prep!
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_006: I'll tell Levi to do a better job.
Affinity_Fricle_EP13_007: She's also working here? You're really something else...
Affinity_Fricle_EP14_001: Being the top witch isn't the only lonely role. A skilled second-in-command deals with that solitude as well.
Affinity_Fricle_EP14_002: Here's a nice, cold drink, on the house.
Affinity_Fricle_EP14_003: Make it a warm one? All this rivalry is giving me chills...
Affinity_Fricle_EP14_004: Then it's probably better to just become the top witch, then, right?
Affinity_Fricle_EP14_005: Maybe someday. But for now, I'm content in Belita's shadow.
Affinity_Fricle_EP14_007: Excluding myself and Lady Belita, the rest are roughly equals, so they're all third-in-command, I guess.
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_001: I often wonder if we're really that similar to the sprites.
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_002: I'm sure you're all different on the inside.
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_003: Inside, the sprites are probably made up of sugar... What about us, though?
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_004: You're all just troublemakers. No different from each other.
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_005: Please recognize the difference between childish pranks and reasonable complaints. Thank you.
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_006: You may come from the same roots, but the environment you live in shapes you as well.
Affinity_Fricle_EP15_007: Hmm, so it doesn't really matter how you were born, right? That makes sense.
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_001: Witches are expert schemers, so doesn't it scare you when we show up at the Banquet Hall?
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_002: If I were scared of my guests, I wouldn't be able to run this Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_003: That's a bold statement. Let's see how long that courage holds up.
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_004: What would they even gain from scheming when we don't even charge for anything?
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_005: Have you given up on everything? Try to perk up a bit. It's no fun crushing someone who's already down.
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_006: You know, you're the scariest one right now.
Affinity_Fricle_EP16_007: Hehe, it's normal to fear me. You'd better not let your guard down.
Affinity_Fricle_EP17_001: What are these things on the Banquet Hall menu? Do they help you stay healthy?
Affinity_Fricle_EP17_002: You think the menu is too simple?
Affinity_Fricle_EP17_003: You do have a variety of options, but it's way too carb-heavy. Eating healthy is important!
Affinity_Fricle_EP17_005: You've spent too much time in the Sprite Kingdom. You're starting to talk just like them. Don't say I didn't warn you.
Affinity_Fricle_EP17_007: I'm eating it, aren't I? I can still speak my mind about my preferences, though, can't I? Sheesh.
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_001: ...There are times when I just want to relax and take a break from everything.
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_002: I'll show you where Kommy likes to take naps. Go and catch a few Z's there.
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_003: That's kind of you. I'd be even more grateful if you'd wake me up right away when someone comes looking for me from the Witch Kingdom?
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_004: If you rest, what happens to the Witch Kingdom?
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_005: I'm not a ruler, just her hands and feet. Even hands and feet need a break sometimes, you know?
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_006: Just get rid of all the troublemakers.
Affinity_Fricle_EP18_007: I've been doing that whenever I get a chance, but they just keep popping up. Witches are tough to control.
Affinity_Fricle_EP19_001: Do sweets really give you energy? You sure?
Affinity_Fricle_EP19_003: But they say that sugar is essential for the brain, and no one puts theirs to work more than we witches.
Affinity_Fricle_EP19_004: Of course. It helps the brain function.
Affinity_Fricle_EP19_005: Thanks for the advice. Sometimes I crave sweets, but I never have a good reason.
Affinity_Fricle_EP19_006: It's like borrowing from your future energy reserves.
Affinity_Fricle_EP19_007: So, sprites are burning through a thousand years of energy reserves? Hold on... does that include our queen, too?
Affinity_Fricle_EP20_001: Do you have potato chips here? I consider them a healthy and satisfying meal.
Affinity_Fricle_EP20_002: Making meals of stuff like that will ruin your health.
Affinity_Fricle_EP20_003: They're fine as snacks, though. Freshly fried potato chips aren't bad once in a while, right?
Affinity_Fricle_EP20_005: Huh? You're making me some? That's pretty, pretty cool of you!
Affinity_Fricle_EP20_006: Keeping boiling oil around is too dangerous.
Affinity_Fricle_EP20_007: That's quite thoughtful of you... Wait, but you have fried carrots!
Fircle_AsideGet: At last, you...! You did it, Picora! Even an illusion is enough... Picora, the one I worry about most...
Fircle_AsideUpgrade: How splendid, Picora...! Well done, well done! I was strict with you only for your own sake.
